response.overview: After 15 years of competing at the highest level and repeatedly reaching the podium, Tristan and Louna Ladevant are changing their approach to their discipline of ice climbing. They are setting aside the pressures of sport to discover the artistic dimension of ice climbing. A frozen waterfall, illuminated in the darkness of night like a theater stage, becomes the backdrop for their icy dance. The curtain rises—it's time for the show to begin.
response.tagline: changing the approach to the discipline of ice climbing
response.title: Ice
